summary: W1 AlembicAgent Stage A for alembic-mainbody-lifecycle-adaptation-2026-06-26. Implement only §4b(A): add plan-selection Agent profile and runPlanAgent producer now that Core shared assertPlanSelectionShape/applyPlanSelection is accepted. No adjacent repo edits. Use @alembic/core/plans PlanSelection + assertPlanSelectionShape; do not invent a local validatePlanSelection with different semantics. Keep profile single-step chat, actionSpace none, memory disabled, projection json-object, maxIterations 1. runPlanAgent must call agentService.run once, pass generationStage/projectContextFacts, throw on non-success/parse failure/invalid shape, allow dimensions.length===1, reject length===0, and avoid repository/sharedState/ledger/tool action use. Export from runs and agent/service surfaces. Validate with Node>=22 build/typecheck, lint, contract-surface, focused profile/run tests covering success/failure/invalid/len1/len0 and no repository/ledger imports. Commit on main and return commit hash, changed files, validation output, raw evidence, residual risks.
